institution: Royal Conservatoire The Hague (Koninklijk Conservatorium) — Institute of Sonology
accreditationStatus: NVAO-accredited Dutch WO master (University of the Arts The Hague)
institutionType: Public conservatoire / university of the arts

Culminates in a thesis plus artistic presentation.

The candidate should have a bachelor's diploma relevant for the professional field of Sonology (composition of electronic and/or acoustic music using fixed media, notation, improvisation or some combination of these, sound synthesis research, sound art, related subjects such as artificial intelligence, computer science or electronic engineering, musicology, music perception, film studies, or as a performing musician). In addition, the candidate should submit a two-page study plan.
acceptsNonMusic: VERDICT: YES. Exact quote: "The candidate should have a bachelor's diploma relevant for the professional field of Sonology (composition of electronic and/or acoustic music using fixed media, notation, improvisation or some combination of these, sound synthesis research, sound art, related subjects such as artificial intelligence, computer science or electronic engineering, musicology, music perception, film studies, or as a performing musician)." — computer science and electronic engineering are named as relevant bachelor backgrounds. portfolioSpec: Verbatim: 'a portfolio with previous compositions, sound installations, recordings of live performances or research results in the form of computer programs, articles, theses, etc.' No number of works, no maximum duration and no file format is specified on the official pages. PLUS a mandatory two-page study plan with four required elements: (1) short description of the proposed project; (2) time planning divided into four semesters; (3) detailed description of the project stating the central research question, context, and form the results will take; (4) an overview of the subjects to be discussed in the thesis for the final examination.

totalCostEstimate: UNVERIFIED — depends on the institutional tuition fee. The Hague living costs roughly €12,000-14,000/year (UNVERIFIED).
scholarships: Not stated on the Sonology admission page. Holland Scholarship / NL scholarship options UNVERIFIED for this institution.

institution: Universitat Pompeu Fabra — Music Technology Group, Department of Information and Communication Technologies
program: Master in Sound and Music Computing (M.Sc.)
accreditationStatus: Official master verified by AQU Catalunya / Spanish Ministry (listed on Canal Universitats as official)
whatYouStudy: Audio signal processing, music information retrieval, musical interfaces, computational musicology, machine learning for audio, sound synthesis; strong research orientation aligned with the Music Technology Group. Interdisciplinary across music, physics/acoustics, engineering (signal processing, AI, HCI, electronics) and psychology (psychoacoustics).
entryRequirements: Verbatim from official FAQ: 'From the provided documents, the excellence in the academic CV as related to the topics of the master is the most important aspect that is considered in the admission process. Another important element is the "Motivation Letter"... The motivation letter should give information not covered in the academic CV, such as information on your music background, on what you understand the master is about, on why you think the SMC master is adequate for you, on your future academic and professional goals... acceptsNonMusic: VERDICT: YES — this programme actively prefers a CS background. program: Master's Programme Computer Music and Sound Art (Computermusik und Klangkunst)
qualification: Master of Arts (MA), course number UV 066 705

institutionType: Public university of music and performing arts
language: German (entrance interview may be held in German OR English)
whatYouStudy: Computer music composition; performance and interpretation of electronic music; conception and development of new electronic instruments; music informatics. Plus history, theory and aesthetics of computer music, and methods of artistic research.

Plus (English page): 'Only after the Dean of Studies has confirmed the equivalency of your preliminary studies you will be notified for the entrance exam.'
acceptsNonMusic: VERDICT: CASE-BY-CASE, leaning NO without strong artistic evidence. There is NO sentence naming computer science or engineering as an accepted background. The rule is a bachelor in Computer Music / Sound Art / Composition and Music Theory 'oder eines gleichwertigen Studiums' (or an equivalent course of study), and equivalency is decided by the Dean of Studies before you are even invited to the exam. Mitigating quote: 'Im Rahmen des Zulassungskolloquiums wird gegebenenfalls festgelegt, in welchem Umfang die Zulassungsbewerber*innen Lehrveranstaltungen aus dem Bachelorstudium „Computermusik und Klangkunst" als Wahlfächer im Umfang bis zu 20 ECTS-AP zusätzlich zu den Lehrveranstaltungen des Masterstudiums zu absolvieren haben, um fehlende oder unzureichende Fähigkeiten gezielt auszugleichen.' — i.e. up to 20 ECTS of bachelor bridging courses can be prescribed to fill gaps. A BSc Software Engineering plus a genuinely strong artistic portfolio is the only realistic route here.
portfolioSpec: Exact: 'two examples or your artistic work, each with a duration of approximately 5 minutes'. Upload at https://go.iem.at/cmkk as a single document or zip file labelled 'surname_firstname'. Either (1) a text file listing online links, or (2) compressed audio/video (mp3, h264 or similar), total size no more than approx. 150 MB, as a single zip. 'There is currently no way to adequately listen to multichannel files in the selection process, so all multichannel work must be reduced to stereo.' Hard warning, verbatim: 'If you do not submit examples of your artistic work, you will not be invited to the examination interview.'
auditionSpec: YES but REMOTE — a major advantage for a visa-needing applicant. Verbatim: 'The entrance exam takes place online.' and 'The oral examination interview takes place via Zoom.' The basis for the interview is formed by two artistic works (for example, sound installations, documentation about the performance or interpretation of music compositions for computer, the development of instruments used in computer music or other usages in the area of music informatics) that the applicant must have handed in as an audio-document or video-document before the application deadline.'
tuitionNonEU: Austrian public universities charge non-EU/EEA students a tuition fee (Studienbeitrag) per semester. Exact amount UNVERIFIED from the programme page.
otherFees: ÖH student union fee per semester — UNVERIFIED amount. Document legalisation/diplomatic authentication of Tunisian degree certificates is explicitly required.
languageRequirement: German language competency is required for admission (separate proof document: 'Required German language competency'). The entrance interview itself may be in German or English. This is a real barrier for this candidate — he does not list German.
englishTest: Not applicable as the primary requirement; German proof is the stated language requirement. UNVERIFIED level.
